headline: Growth accelerates and the outlook is raised
summary_short: Novonesis grew organic sales 8% in H1 2026 (9% in Q2) with a 37.7% adjusted EBITDA margin, and raised full-year organic growth guidance to 7-8%.
summary_long: H1 2026 organic sales grew 8% (Q2: 9%), led by Food & Health Biosolutions (H1 9%, Q2 9%) and Planetary Health Biosolutions (H1 7%, Q2 9%, aided by emerging-market growth net of a roughly 4pp drag from country exits). Adjusted EBITDA margin was 37.7% for H1 (37.6% in Q2); adjusted net profit excl. PPA rose 8% in H1 and 9% in Q2. Free cash flow before acquisitions was 14% of sales; NIBD/EBITDA stood at 1.8x. The board approved an interim dividend of DKK 2.35/share and an inaugural EUR 1 billion share buyback (H2 2026-2029). Full-year 2026 guidance was raised to 7-8% organic growth (from 5-7%), with EBITDA margin guided to the higher end of 37-38%.
confidence_notes: The shard's own eps_usd KPI mixes currency labels (value in DKK, priors in EUR) and was not used in this summary — the release itself does not disclose a single consolidated EPS figure at H1/Q2, only organic growth %, EBITDA margin, and per-share dividend, which are used instead. Figures were read from a GlobeNewswire wire-service reprint (Manila Times) of the H1 2026 report because the company's own PDF (cited as source_url) could not be parsed as text within the fetch budget; a second WebSearch corroborated the same organic-growth and EBITDA-margin figures.

drivers.explanation: Growth was broad-based across both business areas; emerging markets grew 11% in Q2 despite a roughly 4pp drag from exiting certain countries.
Company raised full-year guidance to 7-8% (from 5-7%) on the strength of H1 performance.
